This neuron has no clean semantic trigger — it is a mostly-suppressive, low-signal unit whose weak positive peaks land on word/number-completing tokens in casual first-person narrative or listing text (e.g. "rarely", subword "ises", possessive "'s", "January", a digit in a year, sentence-final "!"), while it is strongly driven negative by connective/filler tokens such as " and", " does", or a year/plural token in sports- and news-style clauses.

L13·N7241unmasked layer
Mostly a suppression neuron for numeric quantity expressions — it goes strongly negative on the digits/currency symbols in prices, percentages and measurements ("(30%)", "£25", "under £40", "56.4 degrees") — while its weak positive side fires on the closing word/punctuation of fixed multi-word phrases and names (" Day" in "World Press Freedom Day", " news" in "good news", ")," after a parenthetical).
